title: Software Engineer
description: Design, develop, and maintain software applications and systems. Solve algorithmic challenges and build scalable technology solutions.

roadmapTemplate.title: Programming Fundamentals
tasks: Learn JavaScript, Python, or Java syntax
Understand basics of OOPs concepts
Practice writing simple console applications

roadmapTemplate.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
tasks: Study arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues
Learn sorting and searching algorithms
Solve 100+ basic problems on LeetCode/GeeksforGeeks

roadmapTemplate.title: Full Stack Web Development
tasks: Learn HTML, CSS, React for frontend
Learn Node.js, Express, MongoDB for backend
Build a complete portfolio project

roadmapTemplate.title: Databases & System Design
tasks: Learn SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB)
Study basic system design patterns (REST, MVC)
Prepare resume and apply for internships

title: Data Scientist
description: Analyze complex datasets using statistical modeling and machine learning algorithms to extract actionable insights and drive business growth.

roadmapTemplate.title: Mathematics & Programming
tasks: Learn Python or R programming
Revise Linear Algebra, Calculus, and Probability
Learn SQL to query structured data

roadmapTemplate.title: Data Analysis & Visualization
tasks: Master Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib libraries
Analyze exploratory datasets (EDA)
Clean and format messy raw files

roadmapTemplate.title: Machine Learning Foundations
tasks: Learn regression, classification, and clustering
Train models using Scikit-Learn
Learn cross-validation and evaluation metrics

roadmapTemplate.title: Deep Learning & Deployments
tasks: Understand Neural Networks, NLP, and Computer Vision
Deploy a model as a simple web API (Flask/FastAPI)
Publish 3 projects on GitHub

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Design user interfaces and craft user experiences for websites and mobile applications. Focus on user research, wireframing, and interactive design.

roadmapTemplate.title: Design Principles
tasks: Learn Typography, Color Theory, and Layout grids
Study basic design heuristics (Jakob's Law)
Analyze popular apps (Spotify, Airbnb) for UI patterns

roadmapTemplate.title: Mastering Design Tools
tasks: Learn Figma inside-out (Auto-layout, Components)
Create wireframes for basic mobile apps
Build click-through interactive prototypes

roadmapTemplate.title: UX Research & Testing
tasks: Conduct user interviews & surveys
Create personas and user journey maps
Perform usability testing on designs

roadmapTemplate.title: Portfolio Development
tasks: Write 3 detailed UX Case Studies
Design full visual mockups
Publish portfolio on Behance or personal website

title: Chartered Accountant (CA)
description: Manage financial audits, taxation policies, accounts, and corporate financial planning for corporations, businesses, and individuals.

roadmapTemplate.title: CA Foundation Course
tasks: Register with ICAI
Study Accounting, Business Laws, Maths, and Economics
Pass CA Foundation exams

roadmapTemplate.title: CA Intermediate Course
tasks: Complete intermediate classes (Group 1 & Group 2)
Master Direct/Indirect Taxes and Audit procedures
Pass Intermediate exams

roadmapTemplate.title: Articleship (Practical Training)
tasks: Secure Articleship in an audit/accounting firm
Work on real audit reports and tax filings
Complete ITT and MCS training courses

roadmapTemplate.title: CA Final Exam & Certification
tasks: Prepare for CA Final Group 1 & 2 exams
Excel in Financial Reporting, Strategic Financial Management
Register as ICAI member

resources.title: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

title: Civil Servant (IAS/IPS/IFS)
description: Administer policy execution, maintain law and order, handle district governance, and implement development programs for the government.

roadmapTemplate.title: Syllabus Analysis & Foundations
tasks: Understand UPSC CSE Exam pattern and syllabus
Read NCERT Textbooks (Classes 6-12) for History, Geography, Polity
Start reading a national newspaper (The Hindu/Indian Express) daily

roadmapTemplate.title: UPSC Preliminary Prep & Optional Selection
tasks: Select optional subject based on interest/background
Prepare GS papers (Polity, Economics, Environment, Science)
Practice CSAT logic and mathematics questions

roadmapTemplate.title: Mains Answer Writing & Revision
tasks: Write daily answers for GS 1-4 and optional papers
Draft mock essays on social, philosophical topics
Take comprehensive test series

roadmapTemplate.title: Interview/Personality Test preparation
tasks: Fill Detailed Application Form (DAF) carefully
Conduct mock interviews with retired civil servants
Stay updated on global and national current events
